note: E6-KD's QAT epoch rules (lane L-AM3, B-2; LB18). E6-KD runs AM-4a item 1's recipe with E3's distillation terms (AM-3; DL-39, DL-51) and AM-4a item 2's selection as AM-21 amends it (its header applies items 2, 4 and 5 to E6-KD). Read by scripts/select_qat_epoch.py and scripts/qat_epoch_eval.py through src/quant/qat_select.py (RULES_FILES), which refuses a disagreement. The qat_epoch block is configs/qat_selection_rules_am23.json's but for stages and source; the clip is configs/qat_selection_rules.json's U4 winner (AM-4a item 3; its qat_clip.inherited_by names E6-KD), so this file holds no qat_clip block.

qat_epoch.source: AM-4; AM-4a item 2; AM-21 item 2(a) and its header; DL-09; DL-38; AM-3; DL-39; DL-51
qat_epoch.value: dataset_level.all_class_miou of the epoch's converted QNNPACK TorchScript artifact, scored by scripts/evaluate_model.py
qat_epoch.excluded: an epoch whose checkpoint fails item 1(a): excluded: non-finite state (AM-21 item 2(a))
